note: Closed table maintained by the content team (contract §13.6, §16.1): which craft-directive nodes of content/craft/text-graph.json the capsule's `style.directives` carries for each Director beat (at most 4 per beat), plus one English line for each of the six style axes and the eleven directives (the keeper carries them into the player's language; `language_applicability` on the text-graph nodes stays data). Every id must exist in the text graph; the kernel validates this at load and never judges prose to pick a line. Three axes and six directives were retired on 2026-09-10 (contract §30.12); the first-turn full form sends every directive node in the graph, so retirement means removing the node, not just the pick. `floor_lines` (2026-09-11, docs/specs/turn-floor.md) are the four content kinds every turn owes, carried as `style.floor` on every turn regardless of beat; they are lines, not counts, and the kernel never judges prose against them.

axis_lines.style-axis:avoid-semantic-repetition: no stale repetition; an echo placed on purpose is not repetition
axis_lines.style-axis:prefer-observable-behavior: observable behaviour over asserted inner states

directive_lines.player-action-uptake: enact the declared action from the world's view
directive_lines.rewrite-abstract-explanation-to-action: inner states become action, voice, posture, gaze, evidence
directive_lines.skill-interpretation-after-visible-evide: skill judgement after the visible evidence
directive_lines.final-prose-guard-before-output: reread: complete natural sentences; context is facts, not phrasing
directive_lines.repetition-policy: settled facts briefly, but as complete sentences; never fragments; enact this action
directive_lines.action-uptake-review: check the draft enacts the action, not the player's phrasing
directive_lines.rewrite-ai-summary-voice: information via scene detail or NPC speech, not report voice
directive_lines.rewrite-camera-direction-staging: one natural sentence names the person and the focus
directive_lines.rewrite-passive-translation-ese: active voice, clear subject, concrete action
directive_lines.rewrite-abstract-psychological-explanati: visible behaviour first; explain after evidence or a skill result

floor_lines: uptake: enact the player's declared action or words from the world's view; one word is still a declaration
answer: settled outcomes perceptible; when nothing settled, someone present acts or the scene changes (director.offer)
voice: anyone present the exchange touches speaks a line in their own voice
handoff: stop only when the player holds enough to judge (scene, clues, people) and has more than one real thing to do; a midpoint with nothing to decide is not a stop; never a menu
